**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast plate with hash browns, scrambled eggs with hot sauce, and a halved bagel or English muffin topped with cream cheese. Food covers roughly a third of the plate, so the meal is modest.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square-ish dinner plate, about 26 cm across (area ~530 cm²). It fills most of the frame, with the food in the left and right portions.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Hash browns (shredded fried potato with onion bits)
- Scrambled eggs with orange hot sauce
- Bagel or muffin half
- Cream cheese spread on the bagel
- Hot sauce (small amount, on the eggs)

**STEP 4 - Volume:**
- Hash browns: ~12% of plate (64 cm²) × 1.5 cm × 0.6 (airy, shredded) ≈ 58 ml → ~60 g
- Scrambled eggs: ~14% (74 cm²) × 1.5 cm × 0.8 (gaps) ≈ 90 ml → ~90 g
- Hot sauce: ~3 g
- Bagel half: ~12% (64 cm²) × 2.5 cm × 0.35 (airy bread) ≈ 55 ml → ~55 g
- Cream cheese: ~40 cm² × 0.6 cm ≈ 24 ml × 1.0 → ~25 g

**STEP 5 - Grams:** Summed above. Eggs and cream cheese at ~1.0 g/ml, bread and shredded potato at reduced density.

**STEP 6 - Energy:**
- Hash browns, fried: 190 kcal/100 g × 60 g ≈ 114 kcal
- Scrambled eggs (with a little butter): 160 kcal/100 g × 90 g ≈ 144 kcal
- Hot sauce: ~20 kcal/100 g × 3 g ≈ 1 kcal
- Bagel/muffin: 250 kcal/100 g × 55 g ≈ 138 kcal
- Cream cheese: 340 kcal/100 g × 25 g ≈ 85 kcal
- Total ≈ 233 g, ≈ 482 kcal

**STEP 7 - Sanity check:** About 230 g of food with roughly 480 kcal fits a single breakfast plate with this visible amount. No adjustment needed.
